# apicp_dns_zone (Resource)

Manages a DNS zone on apicp's own PowerDNS deployment. Created with no NS records — apicp does not manage registrar delegation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apicp_dns_zone" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Zone name, e.g. `example.com`. Stored canonically (trailing dot) by apicp regardless of how it's written here. Changing this replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apicp_dns_zone.example dz_abc123
```
